PI3K/AKT/mTOR signalling pathway in GIST

PI3K/AKT/mTOR signalling pathway in GIST. KIT mutations most frequently occur in exon 11, with additional mutations in exons 9, 13, and 17. The subsequent intracellular signalling network is centrally mediated through the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway, which promotes tumour growth and proliferation. Therapeutic strategies are increasingly focused on deploying specific inhibitors against key signalling nodes—such as PI3K, AKT, mTOR, and the RAS/MAPK pathway—to suppress this oncogenic cascade
